measured_facts.summary: Mock wiring-test measurements normalized from deterministic Agent 10 evidence.

llm_interpretation.summary: Mock mode only; no real LLM evaluation narrative was produced.

rows.question_focus: Transform selected PQC specification/code context into candidate CBMC-style artefacts using an API-backed LLM workflow.
run_evidence: Agent 5 artefact plan and rendered harness are indexed when available.
rows.supported_statement: The run can support a bounded statement about whether the workflow produced candidate intermediate artefacts, subject to whether stages were real API mode or mock mode.
rows.not_supported_statement: The run does not establish that the artefacts are correct, complete, verified, or generally reusable.

rows.question_focus: Use high-assurance PQC/formal-methods workflow ideas to structure the ML-KEM/CBMC case study.
run_evidence: Stages separate candidate generation, review, formal-tool execution, repair, logging, and evaluation.
Agent 7 records property-specific CBMC evidence separately from LLM interpretation.
rows.supported_statement: The run can support evaluation of the workflow structure and trust boundaries.
rows.not_supported_statement: The run does not compare against all high-assurance PQC verification frameworks or prove equivalence to them.

rows.question_focus: Evaluate usefulness, failure modes, and human-correction needs after review, correction, and CBMC checking.
run_evidence: Review gate, counterexample analysis, repair, and logger outputs are indexed where available.
rows.supported_statement: The run can support a case-study evaluation of observed workflow usefulness and failure modes.
rows.not_supported_statement: The run does not support broad statistical claims unless repeated over multiple functions/runs.

rows.label: No formal-tool result because execution was skipped, dry-run, or unavailable
rows.evaluation_implication: The run cannot be used as CBMC verification evidence for the candidate property.

rows.label: CBMC/tool execution error or timeout
rows.evaluation_implication: The next step should address build/tool/unwind/environment problems before semantic conclusions.

rows.label: Verification failure/counterexample available
rows.evaluation_implication: The counterexample analysis and repair/refinement stages become relevant.

rows.label: Verification success is property-specific and scope-limited
rows.evaluation_implication: The success supports only the harness/property/assumption scope, not full ML-KEM correctness.

rows.label: Review gate prevented tool execution
rows.evidence_basis: review_gate={'final_gate': 'human_review_required', 'tool_execution_allowed': False, 'reason': 'Mock LLM review cannot provide clean approval.'}
rows.evaluation_implication: Human review or artefact revision is required before claiming a real tool-execution attempt.

limitations: This taxonomy is derived from logged run evidence.
It does not infer implementation bugs without supporting CBMC/tool evidence.

threats.threat: The run is a selected-function case study, not whole-implementation verification.
threats.mitigation: Report the exact target function, property, harness, assumptions, and CBMC command.

threats.threat: CBMC output is property-specific and harness-specific.
threats.mitigation: Use Agent 7 command/status/output and avoid full-correctness claims.

threats.threat: Some or all LLM stages may be mock/disabled rather than real API mode: {'mock': 5, 'unknown': 2}.
threats.mitigation: Separate mock wiring tests from real API-backed experimental runs.
Use Agent 10 checksums, handoff index, and replay manifest.

threats.threat: A single target function/run cannot justify broad claims about all ML-KEM or PQC code.
threats.mitigation: Frame findings as case-study evidence and discuss need for more functions/runs.
